dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Looks like it's a letter from a child who wants to join the Lightkeepers...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Lately, more and more people have been looking to join us. That's all thanks to everyone’s hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Even the merchants in Nasha Town, who normally don't care about the "public interest," are starting to see why we go to battle.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Who knows? Maybe it won't be long before we become strong enough to rid Nod-Krai of the Wild Hunt threat. What an exciting thought.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But you should come back when you're older...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga's Mailbox
dialogues.text: (It seems to be stuffed full of mail...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's a letter <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> needs to look at...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's a letter <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> needs to look at...)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh, isn't this a letter for Mr. Flins? What's it doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Ah, I get it now... I can't believe you, old man. Even if you sent me, there's no way Flins would accept that puppy you're trying to give him.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... It's been a while since I last dropped in on him.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I should pick a route near Paha Isle next time I go on patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Um... So, I actually received an invitation to Miss Aino's engineering seminar.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: ...Did that happen because I drew everyone's attention when I skipped the last time with that ridiculous excuse?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: What should I do now...? Should I act like I never saw it? Maybe I can still put the letter back where it was...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Never mind. It feels wrong to just act like I didn't see it.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But of course, it'd be a whole different story if I were to be called away on an urgent mission on that day. I should check the mailbox again...
